name: gotoml-marshal-encoding
instr:
I'm restoring TOML encoding in go-toml v2. Please implement `Marshal`, `NewEncoder`, `Encoder.Encode`, the `Encoder.Set*` / `EnableMarshalerInterface` methods in `marshaler.go`, and `RawMessage.MarshalTOML` in `unstable/marshaler.go`.

Follow their doc comments for behavior and layout. Use bare keys where TOML permits them. Raw TOML syntax errors must produce an error. Support signed and unsigned integer map keys using decimal notation. Finite floats use shortest decimal notation without exponents, retaining a decimal point.

For `omitzero`, use a type's `IsZero() bool` method when available, including pointer receivers on non-addressable values; otherwise use Go zero-value equality. Non-nil empty slices are nonzero. Also apply `omitempty` inside inline tables. For `omitempty`, scalar-valued structs such as `time.Time` are empty only at their Go zero value.

Single-line arrays and inline tables use comma-space separators, without padding inside delimiters or trailing commas. Indent annotation comments to the same level as their key-values. These layout rules do not rewrite raw TOML.

Keep public APIs compatible; private helpers are up to you. The module's tests must keep passing. Use ordinary textual Go diffs; added symbolic links, binary Go diffs and quoted-header Go diffs are rejected.

In the non-test Go code you add, please avoid: new `init()` functions; imports of `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys/unix`, `golang.org/x/sys/windows`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `
